evals.prompt: Set up a YOLOv8 object detection pipeline that trains on a custom dataset of 100 labeled images and evaluates mAP on a test split.
evals.expected_output: The agent configures YOLOv8, splits data into train/val/test, trains the model, and reports mAP metrics.
expectations: Dataset split into train/val/test with no leakage
YOLOv8 training completes with logged metrics
mAP reported on the test set with evidence

evals.prompt: Build an OCR pipeline using EasyOCR that extracts text from scanned invoice images and returns structured JSON with vendor, date, and total.
evals.expected_output: The agent integrates EasyOCR, processes images, and parses extracted text into structured fields.
expectations: EasyOCR reader initialized with appropriate language
Text extraction runs on test images without errors
Structured output contains vendor, date, and total fields
